title: P02 — 그 게임의 진짜 발명자 (리지 매기 / US748626)

beats.ko: 가장 많이 팔린 보드게임, 누가 만들었을까요?
beats.en: The best-selling board game ever - who made it?
A jobless man during the Depression, they say.

beats.ko: 그는 이 게임 하나로 백만장자가 됐습니다.
beats.en: He became a millionaire from this one game.

beats.ko: 그런데 삼십일 년 먼저 나온 원본이 있었습니다.
beats.en: But an original came out thirty-one years earlier.
It was made by a woman named Lizzie Magie.

beats.ko: 감옥, 철도, 임대료, 한 바퀴 돌면 월급.
beats.en: Jail, railroads, rent, a salary each time around.

beats.ko: 우리가 아는 규칙이 이미 다 있었죠.
beats.en: Every rule we know was already there.
The company bought the rights for five hundred dollars.

beats.ko: 서류에 적힌 이름은, 리지 제이 매기.
beats.en: The name on the papers: Lizzie J. Magie.
The truth came out in a courtroom in 1973.
She had already died by then.

beats.ko: 그녀는 독점이 나쁘다는 걸 가르치려 했습니다.
beats.en: She built it to teach that monopoly is wrong.
That game is now called Monopoly.
